sandbachFocus: Sandbach United's FA Vase campaign ended in defeat as they fell to Ashby Ivanhoe at home. After going down to a deserved half-time deficit courtesy of Ryman Johnson's unmarked finish in the 14th minute, the Bach improved considerably in the second half but couldn't find the breakthrough needed to turn the tie around. Despite a better second-half display, the visitors held firm to claim the cup upset.
divisionWide: Wolverhampton Casuals extended their unbeaten league record with a narrow away victory at Dawley Town, Liam Kirton netting the decisive goal in the 66th minute. AFC Bridgnorth bounced back emphatically from their midweek draw, thrashing Crewe 4-1 at home with Zazi grabbing a brace. Shawbury United secured another win, edging Widnes Town 3-2 in an entertaining encounter with Ethan Pickford prominent. Bilston Town produced an impressive away display to defeat Brereton Social 3-0 comfortably. In the cup competitions, several big results saw Eccleshall demolish Allscott Heath 4-0 in the FA Vase, while Telford Town advanced on penalties against Darlaston Town after a 1-1 draw. Multiple cup exits for lower-placed sides including Crewe, Cheadle Heath Nomads, Widnes Town, and others, while strong performances from Foley Meir (penalties vs Redditch) and Barnton (3-1 away win vs Irlam) in vase action.
